{{Quote|I hope you've got a steady trigger finger, Striker.''"<br />"''Just put me over the target, Commander.|Ahsoka Tano and Striker|<ref name="HotC" />}}
'''Striker''' was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Striker participated in a [[Battle of the Veil Nebula|battle]] in the [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]] against the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]]. Serving as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] in [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], Striker helped destroy the Confederate base, [[Harko Station]], allowing the Republic to win the battle.

==Biography==
{{Quote|If you want some action, Shadow Squadron, grab your helmets!|Ahsoka Tano, taking Shadow Squadron into battle|<ref name="HotC" />}}
[[File:Battle of the Veil Nebula.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Striker participated in a battle in the Veil Nebula.]]
Striker was the taken name<ref name="HotC" /> of one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Striker was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]]-comprised [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]].<ref name="HotC" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HotC date">{{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}} dates "[[Landing at Point Rain]]" to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Hero of the Confederacy]]'' prior to "Landing at Point Rain," it can be concluded that ''Hero of the Confederacy'' also takes place in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Striker participated in a [[Battle of the Veil Nebula|space battle]] in the [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] and his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of pilots from the planet [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]]. The Republic initially planned to force Vane's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to surrender and use [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] to destroy Vane's base, [[Harko Station]], only as a last resort.<ref name="HotC" />

As such, Striker and the rest of Shadow Squadron were stationed aboard one of the Republic's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] during the early stages of the battle. However, in the midst of the fight, the Valahari activated a signal that forced the [[Neebray/Legends|neebray]] creatures native to the nebula to attack the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. This prompted [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to scramble Shadow Squadron and set off to destroy Harko Station in order to deactivate the signal. Striker served as Tano's [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] during the attack. He dropped a [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] on the Confederate base, and the rest of Shadow Squadron did the same, causing Harko Station to explode. With the signal deactivated, the neebrays fled. Vane was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the Republic won the battle.<ref name="HotC" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all of Jango Fett's clones, Striker had a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
As a clone trooper, Striker was equipped with [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="HotC" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Striker appeared in [[The Clone Wars 12|''The Clone Wars'' 12]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], and illustrated by [[Brian Koschak]],<ref name="HotC" /> and released on [[January 6]], [[2010]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-243/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-12----Hero-of-the-Confederacy|text=STAR WARS: THE CLONE WARS #12 -- HERO OF THE CONFEDERACY}}</ref>
